title: hadid fluid interior · maxxi rome fold
concept: Channel MAXXI Rome interior (Zaha Hadid). ParametricGeometry surface that folds: floor→wall→ceiling with no outside — a möbius-topological interior. Two mirrored surfaces create an enclosed corridor. MeshStandardMaterial cream-white #f0ede8, metalness 0.08, roughness 0.62. Warm key light from one side + cool fill from other. Form suggests inhabitable space, not abstract sculpture.
